ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback. We are very sorry to hear your grill is not getting hot. We are here to help. 

If you are using your grill with the adapter hose to a larger 20 lb. refill/exchange LP tank, it sounds like your grill may be in a safety mode known as “bypass." What’s happening is that the regulator thinks there’s a gas leak, so it reduces the pressure. Follow these instructions to reset the bypass safety mode. This is also the way you would want to start your grill each and every time.

Open the lid
Make sure the control knob is in the off position
Turn your LP tank on all the way
Wait 60 seconds
Turn the burner to start/high (first position to the left)
Hit your igniter
Close the lid to preheat to 500-550°F


For troubleshooting purposes, I would suggest using your grill with a 14 or 16 oz. disposable LP cylinder as well. That will let you know right away if the issue is with the grill, or with the adapter hose/LP tank.

Please look for an outreach email from our Care team soon. Thank you!

ClientResponses.Response:
Your feedback is very important to us. We are very sorry to hear you are having an issue with food sticking. We are here to help. 

With regards to food sticking, we have the following recommendations:

You can oil the food directly, but we do not recommend applying any kind of oil directly to the grates. 

Make sure you're giving your food enough time per side. Food will naturally start to release from the grates when close to flipping time.

 If using a marinade, try to get as much excess liquid off as possible before placing the food on the grill.

If using a sauce of any kind, wait until the last 5 minutes or so to apply.

We recommend cleaning your cooking grates every time you use your grill. Simply preheat the grill on high for 15 minutes with the lid closed and then brush the grates clean with a Weber Stainless Steel Grill Brush.

Our Care team will be reaching out to follow up. Please look for an outreach from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: We initially bought this grill for camping trips, but we find ourselves using it more and more at home. The cooking area is large enough for several burgers/sausages/chicken pieces. The weight is manageable, so I usually move it from the garage to a small table on the deck. The grill is also easy to keep clean. I use the Coleman LP canisters for fuel.
Results.Title: Great small grill

Results.ReviewText:
I was wanting a small, portable grill with good performance to take along camping and that’s what the Q1200 provides.  It easily heats up into the 500° range for searing steaks and I’m pleased with the heat adjustability.  A pleasant surprise is how well the shape drains drippings to the lower grease tray and I’ve had no flare ups whatsoever. 

I purchased an optional bulk tank hose and use a small 10 lb propane tank.  Still highly portable and avoids frequently running out issues with the little 1 lb canisters.
Results.Title: Awesome portable gas grill
